title: The Operating Model Shifted From Expansion to Defense
subtitle: Different evidence types support one strategic story without sharing a misleading numeric axis.

data.label: Insurance cost
data.detail: Protection costs rose sharply after a facility attack.

data.label: Investment plan
data.detail: Management suspended planned expansion while risk was reassessed.

data.label: Warehouse capacity
data.detail: Emergency capacity was sought outside the existing network.

metadata.keyFinding: The evidence is heterogeneous, but every facet supports the same strategic retreat.
